# FLIRT signature provenance

These are FLIRT (Fast Library Identification and Recognition Technology)
signature files vendored from Mandiant's capa project. PAPA uses them to
identify library functions so they are excluded from capability matching,
mirroring capa's behaviour.

## Source

- Project: capa (https://github.com/mandiant/capa)
- Path in the project: `sigs/`
- Raw URL pattern: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mandiant/capa/master/sigs/<name>`
- Retrieved: 2026-05-29
- License: Apache-2.0 (see the LICENSE file beside this one)
- Generated by Mandiant via Hex-Rays FLAIR

| `2_flare_msvc_atlmfc_32_64.sig`   | 7581481      | c6f6084f1553f3a4a515bcefe7a72fe2b3564c8338c01fa9add1166276bf09f1  |

## Embedding

On MSVC the three `.sig` files are embedded into the PAPA executables as
RCDATA resources via `flirt_sigs.rc`, so the binary stays self-contained. At
runtime the registry locks them out of the loaded module. On non-MSVC
toolchains the registry is empty and FLIRT classification is inactive.
